hook: Musi consultation held *a day after* tender bids closed
hook_b: Musi consultation held *a day after* tender bids closed
tldr: MRDCL invited Musi Jan Andolan on Nov 25 to a 90-minute consultation on Nov 28; ADB's bid deadline for Phase I was 5 pm Nov 27. MJA boycotted, calling it meaningless.

beats.what: Musi Jan Andolan, displaced communities and civil society groups boycotted the Musi Riverfront Development Corporation's stakeholder consultation on Saturday.
beats.why: They say Phase I tenders were already issued and the project promoted to investors before any public consultation.
beats.care: MJA wants MRDCL dissolved, a statutory participatory Musi River Basin Authority, a halt to tenders and construction, an ecological reassessment and GO Ms No 921 revoked.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Asian Development Bank, which funds the project, set 5 pm on November 27 as the final bid deadline; civil society groups got the same deadline to confirm attendance.

cards.q: Should public consultation on big city projects come before tenders?

qs: What can a consultation change once bids are in?
Who would sit on a statutory Musi River Basin Authority?

facts.t: MJA lists *5* demands, from dissolving MRDCL to revoking GO Ms No 921 of Dec 16, 2025.
